# LinkedIn Insight Tag

Apply the [media contract](../../media/common.md) and its linked implementation owners.

## Select the LinkedIn route

Establish ad account/use, partner ID, base requirement, conversion/audience objective, conversion
identity or rule method, source event and environment. Research current Marketing Solutions
conversion/tag-manager guidance from https://www.linkedin.com/help/lms/answer/a418880 and inspect
the installed template's base/event capability, version and automatic behavior.

URL/rule-based platform conversion and event-specific browser tagging are distinct selected methods.
Reuse compatible partner/environment initialization and reconcile site/plugin owners. Partner ID,
conversion ID and source event remain separately mapped. Applicable value/ecommerce fields use the
current LinkedIn schema and complete source projection.

## Establish permitted page scope

Inspect current restrictions on sensitive pages/data. The approved page scope must satisfy that
product policy; unresolved eligibility holds the affected implementation. Matching uses the approved
[identity route](../../data/identity.md).

## Verify

Check partner/conversion identity, selected method, page/environment scope, exact fields, consent
and initialization ownership. Campaign Manager conversion creation, domain/source validation and
audiences remain external dependencies.

## Server route

Checked 2026-09-29: redundant Insight Tag+CAPI delivery uses separate source conversion rules,
associated campaigns and one shared occurrence ID. Browser ID field depends on installation method.
See [LinkedIn deduplication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/deduplication).
For Conversions API, load [Server](server.md) for its rule, matching, click identity and token fields.
